title: Mosaic Authoritative Entitlement Contract v1 sync request
description: The request an SDK sends to synchronize its authoritative Entitlement snapshot. Contract negotiation lives in this body; no Configuration Delivery capability request changes.

billingCustomerId.description: A hint only. The server derives the Billing Customer from the Customer Access Token and verifies this value against it; a mismatch is refused. A caller can never select a customer by asserting an identifier, so this member can never widen access.

knownSnapshotVersion.description: The version the caller already holds. The server answers snapshotUnchanged when its current version equals this value and the entity tag also matches.

requestedEntitlementKeys.description: Narrows the response to these keys. Unrecognized keys are project data and are accepted; a key the Project does not define simply contributes no entry.
